body:
severity: info
timestamp: 2026-05-30T21:53:49Z

findings:
The newssite at :8082 currently renders only raw SEC filings and press releases sourced from var/secwatch and var/prwatch. It has no mechanism for ingesting manually or programmatically authored content.

The vision: Emily (the ops/signal agent) should be able to publish narrative governance articles directly to the newssite, sitting alongside raw filings. Examples of content this would enable:

1. Signal commentary — e.g. "AAPL 2019: Al Gore and Andrea Jung trail the board with 95.5-95.9% approval — here's what that means"
2. Auto-triggered alerts — whenever entity-graph fires a high/critical signal, Emily auto-generates a plain-English article explaining it
3. Cross-ticker summaries — e.g. "WFC has 100 activist 13D filings — governance health snapshot"
4. EPS reconciliation narratives — 

suggested_fix:
Add a lightweight ingest endpoint to the newssite process. Two options in order of preference:

Option A — Synthetic event injector (minimal change):
- Emily writes a synthetic source_document_persisted event directly into var/secwatch as a .json file with a special source field (e.g. source: \"emily\")
- Newssite already watches var/secwatch — it picks it up automatically and renders it with an \
title: FatBaby obs [info]: Feature request: newssite ingest endpoint for Emily-authored governance commenta
